chat.prompt.system: You are the ARCA assistant, attached to an offline archive. You answer only from the evidence you are given. Every claim taken from the evidence carries its marker in brackets, [1], [2], and so on. If the evidence does not support an answer, say so plainly and offer to search differently; never invent. On health, medicine, chemistry, hazardous substances or electricity, you either cite the source or state that you do not have one. If you need more evidence, reply with a single line starting with {search} followed by the query, and nothing else. Answer in the language of the question, in short prose.
chat.no_evidence: I do not have it: nothing in the library supports an answer to that. Try other words, or check which collections are enabled.
chat.unavailable: The local model is not available right now. Search and the viewer work exactly the same.
chat.search_budget_spent: I have spent the searches allowed for this turn and found no solid evidence. I do not have it.

home.chat.risk_warning: Sensitive topic with no citation: this answer is not backed by the archive. Verify it before acting on it.
home.chat.selection_hint: Text selected in the viewer: it travels with the question.
home.chat.unavailable: No local model is answering. The archive works the same: searching, opening articles and following their links do not depend on the model.
admin.llama.heading: llama.cpp server
admin.engine.heading: Automatic bring-up
admin.engine.note: You only drop the .gguf model into models/chat. ARCA gets the llama-server engine, deploys it, creates the profile and tests it; if a package does not start, it tries the next one and keeps the first that works. It needs a network the first time.
admin.engine.state.waiting_model: Waiting for a chat model: drop a .gguf file into models/chat and press again.
admin.engine.state.resolving: Asking which llama.cpp release is published…
admin.engine.state.downloading: Downloading the engine; follow the progress in the Downloads tab.
admin.engine.state.testing: Trial start: checking that the engine loads the model and generates text.
admin.engine.state.ready: Chat ready: the engine started, generated text and stayed active.
admin.engine.state.no_network: Without a network the engine cannot be fetched. The library works the same; retry when the connection is back.
admin.engine.state.unsupported: The published release carries no package for this platform. llama.cpp will have to be built by hand and «llama_bin» pointed at it in arca.json.
admin.engine.state.exhausted: No package passed the trial start. Each attempt is detailed in the event log.
admin.engine.state.failed: The bring-up stopped. The exact reason is below and in the event log.
admin.llama.binary_missing: No llama-server binary in the configured path, in vendor/llama.cpp or on the PATH. Chat stays off; everything else works.
admin.llama.log_empty: The process has not printed anything yet.
admin.llama.raw_note: Raw mode replaces the form: this line is used as it is, never mixed with the fields.
admin.llama.sampling_note: Sampling (temperature, top-k, top-p, penalties, seed) goes per request, not on the launch line: configure it in the Chat tab.
admin.llama.other_note: Options the binary's --help reports and the curated layer does not know. They are shown as they are, not hidden.
admin.llama.help_source.binary: Form generated from the installed binary's --help.
admin.llama.help_source.capture: The binary is not available: the form comes from the vendored --help capture.
admin.llama.help_source.none: Neither a binary nor a vendored --help capture: the form cannot be generated.
admin.llama.trial.ok: Profile «{name}» started, answered /health and generated text: it stays active.
admin.llama.trial.rolled_back: Rolled back automatically to the last good profile: «{name}».
admin.llama.trial.no_rollback: There was no previous good profile to fall back to: the server is left stopped.
admin.llama.preflight.context_over_train: Requested context {requested} is larger than the model's trained one ({trained}): the text degrades without warning.
admin.llama.preflight.memory_over_availa: The memory estimate ({needed_gib} GiB) is above the available {target} ({available_gib} GiB).
admin.llama.preflight.gpu_layers_over_bl: You ask for {layers} GPU layers and the model has {blocks}: accepted, it is the usual way of saying «all of them».
admin.llama.preflight.gpu_layers_without: You ask for {layers} GPU layers but the binary is built without GPU support: the symptom will be extreme slowness.
admin.llama.preflight.model_missing: The model given does not exist: {path}
admin.llama.error.no_binary: There is no llama-server engine yet. You do not have to get it: press «Bring the chat up» and ARCA downloads it, deploys it into vendor/llama.cpp and tests it on its own. If you prefer your own build, point «llama_bin» at it in arca.json. Meanwhile chat stays off and everything else works the same.
admin.llama.error.no_profile: No start-up profile is configured. Create one under «Profiles» with the .gguf model you want and save it: the first one saved becomes the default.
admin.llama.error.unknown_profile: That profile no longer exists; it was deleted from another tab or session. Press «Refresh» to reload the profile list.
admin.llama.error.invalid_name: Invalid profile name. Start with a letter, digit or underscore and use only letters, digits, spaces, dots, hyphens and underscores, up to 64 characters.
admin.llama.error.unknown_mode: Unknown profile mode. Only the form and the raw command line exist: reload the page and save again.
admin.chat.heading: Chat
admin.chat.system_prompt_hint: Empty means the default prompt from the catalogue, which already carries the citation rule and the risk-topic rule.
admin.chat.risk_topics_hint: An answer with no citation to a question touching one of these topics is shown with a visible warning.
admin.chat.limits: Hard caps from the specification: {chunks} chunks, {tokens} tokens, {calls} searches.
admin.chat.error: The settings could not be saved: {error}
admin.chat.invalid_sampling: Sampling must be a valid JSON object.
diag.llama_binary.degraded.summary: The llama-server binary cannot be found.
diag.llama_binary.degraded.impact: The chat panel cannot start any local model.
diag.llama_binary.degraded.action: Build or copy llama-server into vendor/llama.cpp, or point llama_bin at it.
diag.llama_server.degraded.summary: The llama-server process is not answering.
diag.llama_server.degraded.impact: Chat does not answer. Search and the viewer work the same.
diag.llama_server.degraded.action: Start it from the llama.cpp section of the dashboard.
diag.chat_model.degraded.impact: The chat panel stays off; the archive works the same.
diag.chat_model.broken.summary: The configured chat model is gone: {name}.
diag.chat_model.broken.impact: Chat cannot start with the current profile.
diag.chat_model.broken.action: Copy the file back into models/chat or pick another model in the dashboard.
admin.search.heading: Search settings
admin.search.doc_weight: Interleaving weight of your own documents
admin.search.weights_note: The weight is how many results each source contributes per interleaving round. Scores from different sources are never compared: results are interleaved by rank.
admin.search.chunk_note: Chunking only affects future imports. Sealed batches are immutable: changing them means reindexing.
admin.search.error: The settings could not be saved: {error}
admin.maintenance.heading: Maintenance
admin.maintenance.verify_running: Walking ZIM files, batches and the database…
admin.maintenance.verify_note: Recomputes the hash of every ZIM, checks every batch manifest against its files and verifies the consistency of library.db. It can take a while: it reads every file.
admin.maintenance.verify_summary: {total} elements checked: {ok} sound, {bad} with a warning.
admin.maintenance.verify_empty: There is nothing to verify yet.
admin.maintenance.col.name: Element
admin.maintenance.export_note: The export carries arca.json and the settings stored in the database. Importing applies only the settings: the library path is never touched.
admin.vendor.index_nothing: There are no vendored pieces on disk to index.
admin.vendor.index_no_server: The embedding server is not answering; the batch is not rebuilt.
admin.vendor.index_failed: The documentation batch could not be sealed.
diag.fulltext_index.ok.summary: The {count} collection(s) carry a full text index.
diag.fulltext_index.degraded.summary: {without} of {count} collection(s) carry no full text index (first: {first}).
diag.fulltext_index.degraded.impact: In those collections only titles are searched: the body of the article stays out.
diag.fulltext_index.degraded.action: Download the flavour that carries the index from the catalogue if you need content search in them.
diag.shard_manifests.ok.summary: The {count} sealed batch(es) match their manifest.
diag.shard_manifests.degraded.summary: {corrupt} batch(es) do not match their manifest: {detail}
diag.shard_manifests.degraded.impact: Those batches stay out of search: their files are not the ones the manifest declares.
diag.shard_manifests.degraded.action: Reindex the batch from the Documents tab, or restore it from a copy.
diag.embedding_coherence.ok.summary: The {count} batch(es) use the embedding model that is active.
diag.embedding_coherence.degraded.summar: {mismatched} batch(es) were indexed with another model or other dimensions: {detail}
diag.embedding_coherence.degraded.impact: Those batches take no part in semantic search. Mixing them would give plausible, false results.
diag.embedding_coherence.degraded.action: Go back to the model they were indexed with, or reindex them with the active one.
diag.provisional_shards.degraded.summary: {count} provisional batch(es) from an interrupted import: {detail}
diag.provisional_shards.degraded.impact: Their documents are not searched yet: the batch is not sealed.
diag.provisional_shards.degraded.action: Run the import again with the same files: it continues where it stopped and seals the batch.
diag.embedding_server.ok.summary: The embedding server answers at {url} and returns {found} dimensions.
diag.embedding_server.degraded.summary: The embedding server does not answer at {url}.
diag.embedding_server.degraded.impact: New documents cannot be imported and meaning based search is off. Word search works the same.
diag.embedding_server.degraded.action: Start the embedding server at {url}, or fix embed_url in arca.json.
diag.embedding_server.broken.summary: The embedding server at {url} does not return the expected {dims} dimensions: {found}
diag.embedding_server.broken.impact: Indexing with it would produce batches that cannot be compared with the existing ones.
diag.embedding_server.broken.action: Check that the server serves the model declared in embed_model, or adjust embed_dims.
diag.chat_model_memory.ok.summary: The chat model fits: {needed_gib} GiB estimated with {context} of context, against {available_gib} GiB of memory.
diag.chat_model_memory.degraded.summary: The chat model asks for {needed_gib} GiB estimated with {context} of context and there are {available_gib} GiB.
diag.chat_model_memory.degraded.impact: It may start very slowly because of swapping, or not start at all.
diag.chat_model_memory.degraded.action: Pick a smaller quantization, lower the context, or offload layers to the GPU if there is one.
admin.manual.heading: Project manual
admin.manual.note: The manual travels inside the application itself and is read without a network. It reflects only what exists and works today.
admin.manual.empty: No manual was found next to the application.
manual.missing: That manual page does not exist.
cli.vendor.llama_pinned: llama.cpp pinned at commit {commit} in sources.lock; «arca vendor» will fetch it.
cli.vendor.llama_bad_commit: «{commit}» does not look like a commit: 7 to 40 hexadecimal characters are expected.
admin.vendor.llama_note: Pin the exact commit you built llama-server from: its sources and documentation are downloaded and stay readable without a network, next to the --help and --version captured from the binary.
admin.vendor.llama_pinned: llama.cpp pinned at commit {commit}; {queued} piece(s) queued.
admin.vendor.llama_error: The commit could not be pinned: {error}
admin.vendor.llama_error.bad_commit: That is not a git commit. Paste the SHA of the llama.cpp release you want to pin: between 7 and 40 hexadecimal characters.
admin.hub.heading: Find and download models
admin.hub.note: Search GGUF models on the configured hub and download the quantization you pick into the models folder. It needs a network: without one, the rest of the panel works the same.
admin.hub.empty: No GGUF model matches that search.
admin.hub.error: The hub could not be reached: {error}
admin.hub.error.gated: That model requires accepting its licence on the hub. Accept it with your account and add «hub_token» to arca.json, or download the .gguf by hand and drop it in models/chat/ inside the library.
admin.hub.error.unreachable: The model hub could not be reached: either there is no network, or the service is down. Try again later or drop the .gguf in models/chat/ by hand; the rest of the panel works without a network.
admin.hub.error.bad_model_id: That model identifier is not of the «author/model» form. Search again and pick a model from the list.
admin.hub.error.bad_kind: Unknown destination: only «chat model» and «embedding model» exist. Reload the page and choose it again.
admin.hub.error.bad_file: That file is not a .gguf from the repository. Open the model variants again and download one of the files listed there.
admin.hub.error.unknown_file: That file is no longer in the repository: the list you see is a few minutes old. Press «See variants» again to refresh it.
admin.hub.no_files: This repository publishes no GGUF files.
admin.hub.queued_no_hash: {filename} queued with no source hash: the computed one is stored for local checks.
